description: Emergenza alluvione 2024 settembre is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Digital maps to support the various activities related to the flood emergency of September 2024 carried out by the Agency for Territorial Security and Civil Protection of the Emilia-Romagna Region. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Flood emergency 2024 September" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2025-03-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
